ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line AB intersects with line MN at point O, with OC $\perp$ AB, and OA bisects $\angle MOD$. If $\angle BON = 25^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle COD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\angle BON = 25^\circ$, \\
then $\angle AOM = 25^\circ$, \\
since OA bisects $\angle MOD$, \\
then $\angle AOD = \angle MOA = 25^\circ$, \\
since OC $\perp$ AB, \\
then $\angle AOC = 90^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle COD = 90^\circ - 25^\circ = \boxed{65^\circ}$.
